text:
Maya Patel: Quick check  branding + press + ops for Redwood x CloudScale x AtlasEdge webinar Fri 10am PT. Need: final speaker bios, sponsor logo order on slides, QR code for post-event survey, booth promo code, rehearsal slots, and press embargo time. Can marketing confirm logo order?
Jen Kim: Marketing here. Logo order: Redwood first, CloudScale second, AtlasEdge third. Please send vector logos (SVG) to the shared folder. Also: we want one co-branded social card (1200x628) and 3 tweet-sized images. Will need copy by Tue noon.
Samir Gupta: Speaker bios  I'll collect short 2-sentence bios from each speaker and drop them in the doc. Also propose embargo until 48h after event for any joint announcement. Thoughts?
Priya Rao: CloudScale ok with 48h embargo. For PR we want a quote from Priya + Marco. Who owns the post-event asset?
Maya Patel: Redwood will own the publication and provide CloudScale + AtlasEdge review window (24h).
Ashley Rivera: Kits update: two sticker variants (round + die-cut) plus postcard + promo code card. No hardware token to avoid customs hassle. Fulfillment: PatchShip confirmed 10bd EU, 14bd APAC. I'll upload SKU mockups.
Marco Duarte: AtlasEdge asks that QR code for demo repo points to a sandbox token link, not production keys. We'll provide tokenized read-only creds.
Leo Chen: Demo failover: if remote inference latency > 300ms for >5s, switch to local fallback. I'll add a small shell script for failover and a fallback banner slide.
Jen Kim: Rehearsal windows: Wed 6pm PT (EU/APAC friendly), Thu 8pm PT (APAC primary), Fri 8:30am PT (final). Can everyone make at least one?
Samir Gupta: I'll block those. Also recording: Redwood stream + local backup on Leo + CloudScale backup. Please opt-in recording consent on registration form.
Ashley Rivera: Customs note: stickers marked as "promotional goods" value $4 to avoid VAT. Will include commercial invoice template in ops doc.
Maya Patel: Visual guidelines: single master deck, please include sponsor slide with logos arranged as Jen specified. Slides due 48h prior. Add slide footer: "Redwood Inference | Partner Webinar" and include co-host handles.
partners-bot: Reminder: attach logos and assets to event doc and set co-hosts CloudScale, AtlasEdge.
deploy-bot: Reminder: run staging stream check Thu 7:45am PT -> deploy test overlay.
Maya Patel: Action items recap: Jen (social assets + logos), Samir (bios + embargo), Ashley (kits mock + customs template + headcount Mon), Leo (failover script + local recording), Marco (sandbox token + loaner serials). Reconvene Thu 9am PT for final run-through. :thumbsup:
